summary: Mirum Pharmaceuticals filed an 8-K under Item 8.01 disclosing that it and partner Incyte announced FDA approval on September 25, 2026 of Atebrioz (zilurgisertib) tablets, a once-daily 100 mg oral ALK2 inhibitor for fibrodysplasia ossificans progressiva in patients aged 12 and older. Approval rests on PROGRESS Cohort 1 data showing mean total new heterotopic ossification lesion volume down 3.2 cm3 versus a 24.6 cm3 increase on placebo at Week 24, maintained through Week 48. No deal terms, board recommendation, advisors, or transaction mechanics are involved; this is a routine product-approval disclosure. Watch US launch in October, the EU marketing application review, and payer access via Mirum Access Plus.
